body: About Darwin AI Darwin AI empowers mid-market companies by automating key business processes with AI-powered digital workers via WhatsApp. Our AI workers handle essential customer interactions, including inbound qualification, outbound reactivation, satisfaction surveys, appointment scheduling, payment collections, and more. As the only no-prompt AI solution on the market, Darwin AI enables mid-market businesses to leverage AI without requiring technical teams or expertise, offering seamless integration and immediate impact. Join a fast-growing team that's changing the way companies think about AI and technology! About The Back-end Developer Position We are looking to hire a top talent back-end Developer to come work with us at Darwin AI (https://www.getdarwin.ai/) You will work closely with our engineers to ensure system consistency and improve user experience. Requirements 3+ year experience working as a Back-end developer Solid experience with the following programming languages: Node.js Python Golang You also need to have experience working with Microservices/AWS. Benefits Language Classes: Access to language classes (English, Portuguese, Spanish) to enhance communication skills OpenAI Premium License: Complimentary access to Gemini premium license for personal or professional use Paid Time Off: Enjoy 25 days/year of paid vacations and holidays to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance Hybrid Work: We meet 2 days/week in our offices, the rest of the time you can work remotely from wherever you like!
